in_marathi.name: Budh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intellect, Wisdom, Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Budh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Budh is the planet Mercury in Hindu astrology. It represents intelligence, wisdom, and knowledge. It is associated with the god Brahma, the creator of the universe.

in_bengali.name: Budh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Intellect, Wisdom, Knowledge
